standard.summary: 在 flow matching 损失上增加对比项：逐样本减去 λ·MSE(预测, 打乱后的负样本目标)，把每个样本的预测流「推离」batch 内其它样本的流方向。需要 Rectified Flow（flow_model）开启。
standard.effect: 主损失变为 loss - cfm_lambda × MSE(pred, shuffled_target)：拉近自己的目标、推远别人的目标。默认关闭，关闭时与基线逐位一致。
standard.whenToUse: 多概念/多风格混训时样本间「流方向」容易平均化、生成结果趋同发糊的场景；论文推荐权重 0.05 起步。
standard.avoidWhen: batch size = 1 时负样本即自身、对比项退化；数据集内容高度同质（同一角色同一姿势）时负样本方向本来就接近，收益小且可能引入排斥噪声。

standard_en.summary: Adds a contrastive term to the flow matching loss: per sample it subtracts lambda x MSE(prediction, shuffled negative target), pushing each sample's predicted flow away from the flow directions of the other samples in the batch. Requires Rectified Flow (flow_model) to be on.
standard_en.effect: The main loss becomes loss - cfm_lambda x MSE(pred, shuffled_target): pull towards your own target, push away from everyone else's. Off by default, and bit-identical to the baseline while off.
standard_en.whenToUse: When training several concepts or styles together and the flow directions average out, leaving outputs alike and muddy. The paper recommends starting at a weight of 0.05.
standard_en.avoidWhen: At batch size 1 the negative sample is the sample itself and the term degenerates; on a highly homogeneous dataset (one character in one pose) the negative directions are already close, so there is little to gain and some repulsion noise to lose.

advanced.principle: ∆FM（Contrastive Flow Matching）：标准 FM 只最小化到自身目标速度场的距离，样本间共享的模型容量会把不同条件的流场拉向均值。加入负项 -λ·MSE(pred, 负目标) 等价于最大化与其它样本目标的间距，增强条件可分性。
advanced.intervention: training_step_loss_execution_core.py：主 loss 计算后、任何加权之前调用 sdxl_flow.apply_contrastive_flow_matching(loss, pred, target, lam)，负样本目标由 batch 内打乱（shuffle）得到；随后的权重对主项与对比项统一缩放。
advanced.expectedImpact: 条件间区分度提升、多概念串味减少；主损失数值会整体下移（因为减了正数项），不要直接与基线 loss 对比。
advanced.tradeoffs: λ 过大时排斥项主导，收敛变慢甚至发散；只在 flow 系（Rectified Flow/Anima/Flux 等）路线有意义，epsilon 预测路线不生效。

advanced_en.principle: ∆FM (Contrastive Flow Matching): standard FM only minimizes the distance to its own target velocity field, and the model capacity shared across samples pulls different conditions' flow fields toward the mean. Adding the negative term -λ·MSE(pred, negative target) is equivalent to maximizing separation from other samples' targets, strengthening condition separability.
advanced_en.intervention: training_step_loss_execution_core.py: after the main loss and before any weighting, calls sdxl_flow.apply_contrastive_flow_matching(loss, pred, target, lam), with negative targets obtained by shuffling within the batch; subsequent weighting scales main and contrastive terms uniformly.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Better inter-condition separation and less multi-concept flavor bleeding; the main loss value shifts down overall (a positive term is subtracted) — do not compare directly against baseline loss.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: With λ too large the repulsion term dominates — slower convergence or divergence; only meaningful on flow-family routes (Rectified Flow/Anima/Flux etc.), no effect on epsilon-prediction routes.
